name: Qat

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Absalom, City of Lost Omens

text:
Activate 1 Interact

---

The save for addiction to qat is DC 14 Fortitude save, but the maximum addiction stage of qat never progresses beyond stage 1.

Saving Throw DC 14 Fortitude save

Onset 10 minutes

Maximum Duration 8 hours

Stage 1 +1 item bonus to Reflex saves (10 minutes)

Effect: Qat (Stage 1)

Stage 2 Stupefied 1 (1 hour)
